violated_contract: Every code path that names a storage bucket or blob must work under the self-hosted LocalStorageClient backend (backend/utils/other/local_storage.py), not only under real GCS: a bucket-name env var with no Python-level default, a call site with no None guard, or a blob name shaped like a local filesystem path (not GCS's more permissive key namespace) will pass on GCS and crash the moment the same code runs against local storage.
canonical_prevention: When adding or touching a storage.py bucket-backed path (a new BUCKET_* env var, a new .bucket()/.blob() call, or a blob name derived from a local path), exercise it against LocalStorageClient in a unit test (see backend/tests/unit/test_local_storage.py) before assuming GCS-only testing covers it. A bucket name with no sane default and no None-guard at every call site, or a blob name built from an absolute local path, are both instances of this class.
